import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    void execute() {
        try {
            BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);
            
            int caseCounter = 1;
            while (true) {
                String[] line = reader.readLine().split("\\s+");
                int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
                if (n == 0) break;
                
                writer.println("@" + caseCounter++);
                
                double[] circles = new double[n];
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    line = reader.readLine().split("\\s+");
                    int x = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
                    int y = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
                    int r = Integer.parseInt(line[2]);
                    circles[i] = r;
                }
                
                int regions = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    regions++;
                    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                        double dist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(circles[i] - circles[j], 2));
                        if (dist < circles[i] + circles[j] && dist > Math.abs(circles[i] - circles[j])) {
                            regions++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                writer.println(regions);
            }
            writer.close();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    static class Point {
        double x, y;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        Point add(Point other) { return new Point(x + other.x, y + other.y); }
        Point sub(Point other) { return new Point(x - other.x, y - other.y); }
        
        Point rotate(double angle) {
            double cos = Math.cos(angle);
            double sin = Math.sin(angle);
            return new Point(x * cos - y * sin, x * sin + y * cos);
        }
        
        Point normalize() {
            double len = length();
            return scale(1.0 / len);
        }
        
        Point scale(double factor) { return new Point(factor * x, factor * y); }
        
        double length() { return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y); }
    }
}
